family.description: The spike structure of bacteriophage PRD1 is comprised of proteins P2, P5, and P31. P5 is an elongated multidomain trimer. This domain is found at the N-terminal of bacteriophage PRD1 spike protein P5 and mediates the interaction with protein P31. The C-terminal domain appears to contain the residues responsible for the trimerization of the protein [[cite:PUB00032209],[cite:PUB00088279]].
family.name: Bacteriophage PRD1, P5, spike N-terminal
